hsflowdBanner: sFlow: VPP samples packets on the selected interfaces, but exporting the samples to sFlow collectors needs the hsflowd daemon, which is not shipped yet. IPFIX (flowprobe) export works without it.
notGlobalsOwner: This agent is not the owner of VPP-global settings: exporter 0, flowprobe and sFlow parameters are only checked, never set.

exporters.help: The first enabled exporter with an IPv4 collector (by name) becomes IPFIX exporter 0 — the only one flowprobe records are sent through. Other exporters serve other producers (e.g. NAT logging).
exporters.name: Name

flowprobe.help: Flow records per interface, exported through exporter 0. VPP records one variant per interface: IPv4, IPv6 or L2.
flowprobe.needsExporter: Flowprobe needs an enabled exporter with an IPv4 collector.

sflow.help: Random packet sampling, 1 in N packets, on the selected interfaces.
